description: 6 pages with a constant header (position/font/width) but a varying page number in the text, plus a footer with the page number alone — tests matching by conjunction, not by exact text.

expected.note: Construction fact: each of the 6 pages has 1 header line (x=72,y=760, in the band >93% of the height), 4 body lines (y=650..590), 1 footer line (x=300,y=30, in the band <7% of the height, the text = the page number alone). The header/footer text DIFFERS on every page (the page number). detectRunningElements() should detect the header ON ALL 6 pages despite the different text (matching by position+font+width, not by text) and the footer likewise.
